steps.user_message: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.agent_response:
Sounds lovely — glad you had a relaxing weekend with Maria!

If you want, I can help turn that into an email to share with family or friends. Here are a few quick options you can pick from or edit:

Subject line suggestions
- Weekend in the countryside with Maria

- Relaxing nature weekend

Short email drafts

Hi [Name],
I spent the weekend in the countryside with my sister, Maria. We explored some beautiful nature trails, breathed fresh air, and had a really relaxing time. I’ll send a few photos soon — it was exactly what we needed.
Hope you’re doing well!
— [Your name]

2) Family update
Hi everyone,
Just a quick note to say Maria and I went away for the weekend to the countryside. We did some easy hikes, enjoyed the fresh air, and relaxed — it felt great to unplug for a bit. We’ll share pictures when we get them sorted.
Love,
[Your name]
